headlines.description: — Michael Conforto homered and singled, Nico Hoerner had three hits and an RBI and the Chicago Cubs beat the Miami Marlins 6-5 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Conforto homers, Hoerner has 3 hits to lead the Cubs past the Marlins, 6-5

events.name: San Francisco Giants at New York Mets

headlines.description: — Rafael Devers and Christian Koss each homered twice Saturday, powering the San Francisco Giants to a 9-5 win over the New York Mets.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rafael Devers and Christian Koss both homer twice as Giants roll to 9-5 win over Mets

headlines.description: — Zack Wheeler struck out nine in six sharp innings, Kyle Schwarber hit his MLB-leading 41st home run and the Philadelphia Phillies pulled within four games of the first-place Braves in the NL East with a 4-2 victory over Atlanta on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wheeler fans 9 in 6 sharp innings, Schwarber hits 41st homer to lift Phillies past Braves 4-2

headlines.description: — Riley Greene hit two solo homers, had a season-high four hits and drove in four runs, and Framber Valdez threw seven innings to help the Detroit Tigers beat the Cleveland Guardians 6-0 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Riley Greene homers twice, drives in 4 runs in the Tigers' 6-0 win over the Guardians

events.name: Los Angeles Angels at Pittsburgh Pirates

headlines.description: — Yusei Kikuchi pitched six scoreless innings and earned his first win of the season as the Los Angeles Angels beat the Pittsburgh Pirates 6-1 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Yusei Kikuchi pitches 6 scoreless innings to lead Angels to a 6-1 win over the Pirates

headlines.description: — Matt McLain snapped a seventh-inning tie with a leadoff homer and the Cincinnati Reds held on to beat the Milwaukee Brewers 5-3 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Reds hit 3 home runs and hold on for 5-3 victory over Brewers

events.name: Boston Red Sox at Baltimore Orioles

headlines.description: — Sonny Gray pitched seven three-hit innings for his majors-leading 17th victory to help the Boston Red Sox beat the Baltimore Orioles 5-0 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gray throws 7 strong inning in majors-leading 17th win, Red Sox beat Orioles 5-0

events.name: Tampa Bay Rays at Texas Rangers

headlines.description: — Jonathan Aranda hit a three-run home run in the 10th inning to give the Tampa Bay Rays a 6-3 victory over the Texas Rangers on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Aranda hits 3-run homer in the 10th to give Rays a 6-3 win over the Rangers

events.name: Minnesota Twins at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: — Ryan Jeffers hit a go-ahead, three-run home run in the fifth inning and Taj Bradley settled down after a rough start to lead the Minnesota Twins to a 6-4 win over the Chicago White Sox on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ryan Jeffers hits a three-run home run to help Minnesota Twins to a 6-4 win over Chicago White Sox

events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at Kansas City Royals

headlines.description: — Kazuma Okamoto had four hits and two RBI, including a tiebreaking single in the seventh inning, as the surging Toronto Blue Jays beat the Kansas City Royals 4-3 on Saturday night to pull even with Cleveland for the final American League playoff spot.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kazuma Okamoto leads Blue Jays past Royals 4-3 to pull into tie for last AL wild card

headlines.description: — Gabriel Moreno hit a tiebreaking RBI single in the 10th inning and the Arizona Diamondbacks rallied for a 4-3 victory over the Houston Astros on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Moreno's go-ahead RBI single in 10th gives D-Backs 4-3 win over Astros

events.name: New York Yankees at San Diego Padres

headlines.description: — Spencer Jones hit a two-out RBI double against his hometown team to start a four-run rally in the second inning, and the New York Yankees beat the San Diego Padres 5-1 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Spencer Jones starts key rally against hometown team as Yankees beat Padres 5-1

events.name: St. Louis Cardinals at Colorado Rockies

headlines.description: — Cole Carrigg had two hits, including a leadoff single to spark a six-run fifth inning, and the Colorado Rockies beat the St. Louis Cardinals 10-7 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rockies use 6-run 5th inning to beat Cardinals 10-7

events.name: Washington Nationals at Los Angeles Dodgers

headlines.description: — Tommy Edman and Teoscar Hernández provided key hits in Shohei Ohtani's absence as the Los Angeles Dodgers rallied for a 6-5 victory over the Washington...
headlines.shortLinkText: Tommy Edman and Teoscar Hernández lead Dodgers past Nationals 6-5 in Shohei Ohtani's absence

headlines.description: — Jeffrey Springs pitched seven scoreless inning, Max Muncy homered for the second straight day and the Athletics beat the Seattle Mariners 6-2 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Springs throws 7 shutout innings, Muncy homers as A's beat Mariners 6-2
